# hpe_morpheus_script_template (Data Source)

Provides a Morpheus script template data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_script_template" "example_script_template" {
  name = "Terraform Example Script Template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the Morpheus script template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
